_comment: Bar-line edit of v3 take 2 (music_v1, seed 3313) onto the v4 film clock (133 s). v4 re-edit of the v3 arrangement (backup tools/audio-v3/_v3/data/arrangement.v3.json): the groove runs 1 s longer (half of its last bar repeated) to the hard stop on 59 (a beat), the tension starts at 60 as before, the sub hit moves to 67.5, the blocked strip to 110.5, and the ring-out is faded 1 s earlier so the last 0.5 s are silent at 133. The drop (76) and the landing (122) did not move. Raw take: sparse glockenspiel intro 0-8; bright groove 8-64; low drone 64-73.5 fading to silence by 76; 1-bar riser 76-78; DROP on 78; driving groove 78-126; held chord 126-129 and a clean ring-out to silence by 133.9.

segments.why: M1-M3: the groove kicks in on hookLand (source bar 8 + 1 beat, so bars stay on even seconds)
half of the last groove bar again, up to the hard stop on 59
M4: hard stop at musicStop; Night falls (the muted pluck is an SFX)
drone again (seamless repeat), its fade to silence, the 1-bar riser, the DROP on 76, the tech groove
M8/M9: the landing repeats one groove bar, then the held chord on 126 and the ring-out

gain.why: the drone sits under the heartbeat
near silence after the sub hit (the take's own fade continues to 74)
gentle extra fade so the take's ring-out still sounds at endPress and ends by 132.5

sweeps.why: Night: the drone darkened to a low pad
M7: the band drops to bass and tick for 2 bars
M8: high-pass build, snapping back full on the landing

synth.why: M4: dull thud when the slip is used

subHits.why: M4: the deep sub hit (subHit) before 'So how does a buyer know it's clean?'

cues.what: glockenspiel pickup; the groove kicks in on hookLand 2.5
the same groove (no separate chorus in the take)
hard stop on 59, silence to 60, dark drone + heartbeat + ticks, thud 66, sub hit 67.5, near silence
fade to silence, 1-bar riser 74-76, DROP on 76
bass + tick for 2 bars (110.5-114.5), band back to 116
high-pass build 116-122, LANDING on 122 (sub hit, full band)
held chord on 126, ring-out faded by 132.5, silent 132.5-133
